gaps: The camera's far plane is a fixed 20 km (engine.ts:209 in the constructor) and the fog follows the drawn content; for an extent much wider than about 12 km the far edge of the fitted view may be clipped until the officer moves closer. The normal area framing has the same limit.
The sentence says 'recorded' because the window counts only recorded features on staging; once proposals are counted (displayState), the words may name proposals too.
The window and canonical frames may differ by grid convergence (LA1 gap 1), unchanged here.
